developer.bio: Full Stack Developer focused on well-built interfaces, scalable backends, and digital experiences that combine clarity, performance, and real value.
developer.availability: Open to opportunities, collaborations, and conversations about technology.
summary: From an early age, curiosity about how websites, systems, and games work brought me closer to programming. Starting from game modifications and the desire to understand what happened behind the interface, a genuine relationship with technology was born.
Today I act as a full stack developer building web applications and complete solutions, from frontend to backend, through architecture, integrations, deployment, observability, and software quality.
I enjoy environments where product, engineering, and user experience walk together. My goal is to create useful, solid, and pleasant-to-use software.
